description: Sanz Rodrigo, Javier and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The implemented benchmarking resource supplies Jupyter notebooks for assessment of wind-farm wake models under the Offshore Wind Accelerator research programme. Native software metadata and the public CENER-EPR/OWAbench repository establish the computational tool. GitHub identifies GPL-2.0 terms; the native deposit does not state a licence label. Challenge datasets remain separately catalogued and do not become identical to the notebook implementation. Detailed current compatibility and uniform coverage of every challenge case are not established. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label unknown. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
